//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the BASIC-LIST component — the styled <ul> block pa-list-basic (keen `List.basic_list/1`, svelte `display/BasicList.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. Like list.json, the harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (HTML-escaped by the dumper), so real <li> item markup can't flow through the slot; the body is a bare text token. This fixture proves the container's tag (<ul>), its pa-list-basic class + every modifier, and its class passthrough. SIBLING blocks pa-list (complex, list.json) / pa-list-ordered (ordered-list.json) / pa-list-definition are DIFFERENT components, out of scope. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/lists.html + _lists.scss.

propsVocabulary.spacing: inter-item density compact|spacious — emits pa-list-basic--{spacing} (default = no modifier)
propsVocabulary.hasIcon: boolean — shows ::before icons, green ✓ by default (pa-list-basic--icon)
propsVocabulary.iconVariant: icon colour success|danger|info|warning — COUPLED to hasIcon: emits pa-list-basic--{iconVariant} ONLY when hasIcon is true AND iconVariant != success (success is the default ✓ and has NO modifier class in core). These semantic modifiers only style the ::before pseudo, which exists only with --icon.
propsVocabulary.body: the list's item area — plain slot text in this container-only slice (real <li> children are out of scope)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural. The container is a <ul class="pa-list-basic …">. spacing emits pa-list-basic--{value}; the booleans each emit their modifier; the icon-variant emits pa-list-basic--{variant} only under the hasIcon+non-success coupling (see iconVariant). There is NO pa-list-basic--success (default). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-list-basic--'): compact, spacious, unstyled, inline, bordered, striped, icon, danger, info, warning. NO --success (default). iconVariant is type-coupled like loader's size (emits pa-list-basic--{variant} only with hasIcon && variant!=success), so its produces is null and it is verified via scenarios/goldens + claimed via cssStateClasses. body/extraClass produce null (structural/passthrough).

iconVariant.note: coupled — emits pa-list-basic--{variant} only when hasIcon is true AND variant != success. success is the default (no class). Verified via scenarios + claimed via cssStateClasses.

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; <li> items are out of scope

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: The icon-variant classes (danger/info/warning) are the iconVariant feature's coupled output (see its note). Listing them here claims them so capability axis-1's reverse-check over pa-list-basic--* passes (the single-template expander can't express the hasIcon+non-success coupling).

scenarios.name: icon-default-success
scenarios.note: hasIcon with default success → only --icon, NO --success class (success is the default ✓).

scenarios.name: icon-success-explicit
scenarios.note: Guard: explicitly passing success must NOT emit a phantom pa-list-basic--success.

scenarios.name: variant-without-icon
scenarios.note: Guard: iconVariant without hasIcon emits NO modifier — the semantic class only styles the ::before pseudo, which needs --icon.

scenarios.name: combined
